scope: Historical 305 m Arecibo Telescope after the Gregorian upgrade, with the spherical reflector, ground screen, three towers, cable anchorages and suspended receiver assembly as documented in 2006.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The forensic report describes the three concrete towers, 305 m spherical primary, 1997 Gregorian upgrade, three sets of six main cables, backstays and operational history before the 2020 collapse.
NASA planetary data record gives the geoid elevation at the reflector center of curvature as 496.84 m.
Published parameters specify 305 m clear diameter, 265 m curvature radius, 15 m ground screen, 100 m azimuth arm and 22 m Gregorian secondary.
Observatory engineering notes document the tower cable pin near elevation 1,386.5 ft and platform near 1,256.1 ft. Original reflector panels were roughly 3 by 6 ft with long sides east-west.
Observatory scientist reports the surveyed reflector center of curvature at 497 m and general configuration.
